Thursday, June 9, 2022  6:00 PM  Teleconference

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a Special Meeting of the Park & Activities Commission of the City of
Rolling Hills Estates will be held on Thursday, June 9, 2022 at 6:00 p.m. via Video Teleconference. The agenda
for the special meeting with the items to be discussed is set forth below.

  Posted by the office of Community Services on Wednesday, June 8, 2022

Public Participation Information
  In accordance with Assembly Bill 361 (AB 361) and City Council Resolution No. 2487, due to the
  continuing state of emergency, including masking and social distancing directives as a result of the threat
  of the COVID-19 virus, this meeting is being held remotely via teleconference. There will not be a physical
  location for this meeting. Members of the public may participate in the meeting in the following ways:

  - Members of the public may listen to the meeting live by calling: (1 669 900 6833) from any phone,
  Meeting ID: 820 1617 0882, Meeting Password: 339794. (Please note you will not have the ability to
  speak using the call in option from a phone line.)

  - Members of the public may also comment online using eComment on the “Meeting Agendas, Minutes &
  Videos” page of the City’s website (www.rhe.city/MeetingAgendas). Once the agenda is published, there
  will be an “eComment” button next to the linked agenda under "Upcoming Events". Follow this link to
  the City’s SpeakUp page. After you register, you may comment on any item on that particular agenda.
  These comments can be seen by the public, will be considered by the Council and become part of the
  record.

  - Members of the public who wish to speak during this meeting may join the Zoom meeting by accessing the
  Zoom app from a computer (downloaded at Zoom.com) or tablet or phone (downloaded in the App Store),
  by entering the following credentials: Meeting ID: 820 1617 0882, Meeting Password: 339794. Members
  of the public who join the Zoom meeting will not have video, and may request to speak using the following
  process: After joining the Zoom meeting, if you wish to speak, please select the "raise hand" option at the
  lower portion of your screen. The City Clerk will send you a chat message to identify which item on the
  agenda you would like to speak on and will unmute your mic at the appropriate time.

  Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each Open Session agenda item are
  available on the City's website under Meeting Agendas, Minutes & Videos at www.rhe.city.

MINUTES
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION SPECIAL MEETING
  JUNE 9, 2022

  1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

  A special meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates
  was called to order at 6:02 p.m. via teleconference, by CHAIR CIAROLLA.

  2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

  3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Bain, Ciarolla, Persichina, Pope, Romanelli

  Commissioners Absent:  McCormick, Retz

  City Staff Present:  Assistant City Manager Alexa Davis
  Community Services Supervisor Rosa Pinuelas

  4.  AUDIENCE ITEMS NOT ON THE AGENDA

  None.

  5.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A.  EQUESTRIAN FACILITY FEES REVIEW UPDATE

  ACM Davis gave a brief overview of the staff report.

  VICE CHAIR BAIN made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER POPE to:

  APPROVE THE REVISIONS TO THE EQUESTRIAN FACILITY FEES TO BE
  INCORPORATED INTO THE FEES AND CHARGES SCHEDULE AS APPROVED
  AND ADOPTED BY THE CITY COUNCIL.

  There being no objection, CHAIR CIAROLLA so ordered.

  B.  HORSE TRAINER PERMIT CATEGORY AND FEES UPDATE

  ACM Davis gave a brief overview of the staff report.

PARK AND ACTIVITIES MEETING MINUTES  1
JUNE 9, 2022
   COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA asked how the City would enforce trail riding
  businesses.

  ACM Davis responded that due to recent experiences with a trail riding operator,
  staff is now familiar with local trail riding businesses and is able to connect as
  needed. She added that self-reporting and communication with the local equestrian
  community also supports compliance. ACM Davis noted that some of the trail riding
  businesses were categorized as trainers under existing provisions

  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI asked about the City usage fee and how it differs
  from the permit fee. ACM Davis explained that it is similar to the Special Event
  application in that the permit fee pays for staff to review the application and the
  usage fee pays for the actual use of the City property. COMMISSIONER
  ROMANELLI asked for the Equestrian Committee’s view of the usage fee and if
  any guidance was given regarding of this fee. ACM Davis responded that the
  Equestrian Committee reviewed the fees and are recommending as it has been a
  while since the fees have increased. The Committee felt Category 2 should not be
  increased too much since usage of the facility is not frequent, but that Category 4
  fees should be increased. ACM Davis shared that staff informed trainers that this
  item was being considered. COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI asked if the fees would
  prevent outside trainers from operating in the City. ACM Davis responded it would
  not prevent them from operating in the City adding that any new trainers who come
  in after July 1st would be subject to the new fees, but the current trainers who have
  already paid their fees for the year (at the current rates) would still be covered
  through the end of the calendar year.

  CHAIR CIAROLLA stated it has been ten years since the fees have been raised
  and that each year a small increase would be discussed moving forward.

  VICE CHAIR BAIN asked if there are any comparisons of fees from similar cities.
  ACM Davis responded that no other city has trainer fees comparable.

  VICE CHAIR BAIN made a motion, seconded by CHAIR CIAROLLA to:

  APPROVE THE REVISION TO HORSE TRAINER PERMIT CATEGORIES
  AND FEES AS PROPOSED TO BE INCORPORATED INTO THE FEES
  AND CHARGES SCHEDULE AS ADOPTED BY THE CITY COUNCIL AND
  RECOMMEND CITY COUNCIL REVIEW AND APPROVE THE UPDATE
  TO MUNICIPAL CODE CHAPTER 5.04 RELATED TO HORSE TRAINER
  PERMITS.

  AYES: Bain, Ciarolla, Persichina, Pope, Romanelli
  NOES: None
  ABSENT: McCormick and Retz

PARK AND ACTIVITIES MEETING MINUTES  2
JUNE 9, 2022
   The motion carried.

  C.  PROPOSED PICKLEBALL FEES

  Community Services Supervisor Pinuelas gave a brief overview of the staff report.

  VICE CHAIR BAIN asked about instructor agreements for pickleball lessons before
  the end of summer and rental reservations for pickleball play. Community Services
  Supervisor Pinuelas responded that staff reviewed the instructor contract with the
  City Attorney and is in process of creating a volunteer contract for the USA
  Pickleball Ambassador volunteers to run the drop-in program and then work toward
  having lessons. In response to VICE CHAIR BAIN, Community Services Supervisor
  Pinuelas responded that staff is working to have lessons in Fall but the drop-in
  program would begin before the end of Summer. In response to VICE CHAIR BAIN,
  Community Services Supervisor Pinuelas responded that it would take place by
  phone and that staff will work with the ambassadors on how best to coordinate that.
  VICE CHAIR BAIN asked Supervisor Pinuelas about the court reservation process
  for pickleball. Supervisor Pinuelas explained that the court reservation process for
  pickleball would be the same as it currently is for tennis but that the pickleball drop-
  in program would be run at specified times. VICE CHAIR BAIN asked if an
  electronic reservation system would be considered in the future. Supervisor
  Pinuelas responded that an electronic reservation system is being researched for
  possible future use.

  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI asked if the pickleball courts have been numbered
  yet. Community Services Supervisor Pinuelas responded that the courts were not
  formally numbered yet, but that staff has assigned numbers to the courts and makes
  sure to fill up both pickleball courts of a tennis court before allowing use of another
  tennis court. COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI suggested making placards or signs
  to assist future pickleball players when they begin to call in to reserve courts.

  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI made a motion, seconded by VICE CHAIR BAIN
  to:

  APPROVE STAFF RECOMMENDATION OF THE ADDITION OF
  PICKLEBALL FEES TO BE INCORPORATED INTO THE FEES AND
  CHARGES SCHEDULE TO BE APPROVED AND ADOPTED BY THE CITY
  COUNCIL.

  AYES: Bain, Ciarolla, Persichina, Pope, Romanelli
  NOES: None
  ABSENT: McCormick and Retz

  The motion carried.

PARK AND ACTIVITIES MEETING MINUTES  3
JUNE 9, 2022

  ADJOURNED THE MEETING AT 6:38 PM TO THE NEXT ADJOURNED PARK
  AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING ON JUNE 20, 2022, AT 6:00 P.M.,
  WHICH BE HELD AT ERNIE HOWLETT PARK, 25851 HAWTHORNE BLVD.,
  ROLLING HILLS ESTATES, CA 90274.

  There being no objection, CHAIR CIAROLLA so ordered.

  Respectfully submitted,  Approved,
